def _format_relative(self, humanized, timeframe, delta):
    if timeframe == "now":
        return humanized
    direction = self.past if delta < 0 else self.future
    r = direction.format(humanized)
    if timeframe == "seconds":
        r = r.replace(" ", "")
    return r
